title: Shape Attributes Worksheets: Sides, Corners, and Faces
intro: Teach the attributes of flat shapes and solids with objects students can handle.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Trace sides and corners on a flat shape. Then touch the flat faces of a cube and name the different features.

Ask your student

Are we counting a side of a flat shape or a face of a solid?

If your student needs help

If the terms are confused, place the flat shape beside a cube and point to each feature.
